why: An MCP client starts the file a tracked config launches on every session, and the launch text of .mcp.json never changes when that file does. Both sides track the template .mcp.json. The pass side tracks .rebar/mcp.mjs as version 2 of rebar's template (blob 8bc5d7f, 45,574 bytes, what rebar-site tracks), a blob no later commit can change, so the case never ages and it passes with the update note; the fail side tracks version 1 (blob 6cf8634, 10,416 bytes), a launcher rebar shipped that runs npx --yes github:Navesz/rebar --mcp, unpinned, every time the client starts it. Whoever judges the launch and not the bytes, or accepts every version rebar ever shipped, turns the fail side green; whoever accepts only the current template turns the pass side red, and with it rebar-site and assay, which track versions 2 and 6. Unknown bytes fail in mcp-integrity__not-applicable.
